summary.intent: Execute all 13 plans of Phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability + Rust engine twin + desktop FUSE live-wiring) using wave-based parallel execution with independent git worktrees for concurrent plans, then validate the phase via a real-mount desktop-e2e acceptance run.
summary.outcome: All 13 plans landed across 7 waves with green gates (depth-3 crash-safety e2e 6/6, sdk-core 363, sdk 362, cargo cipherbox-sdk 146, cargo cipherbox-fuse 106); two genuine product bugs were found and fixed (dirty-frontier decrypt-before-check ordering in both engines, and desktop sent_shares cache never refreshing causing universal EIO). The CI desktop-e2e run against the pushed branch failed on macOS/Linux at the new Step 8 leg (shared file never propagated to recipient), Windows didn't run Step 8 at all (only run-all.sh had it, not run-all.ps1) — mid-fix for Windows parity when the transcript ends, with a debugger about to be spawned to repro Part A locally via headless UAT.

repo: Desktop E2E has two separate harnesses: macOS/Linux use tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh, Windows uses run-all.ps1 — a new test step must be added to both or it silently doesn't run on Windows.

crates/sdk's anti-rollback floor sidecar (rotation-high-water.json) lives inside the cb-journal/ directory; WriteQueue::load_all scans all *.json there and logs benign 'missing field id' warnings for it — pre-existing since Phase 69, not a bug.

CipherBox delete is a soft-delete (moves to private recycle bin, re-seals keys) — structurally equivalent to a cross-folder move, which is why it triggers scope-exit rotation even though hard-delete semantics might suggest otherwise.
Rotation only fires on cross-folder moves/deletes (parent != newparent in rename.rs:134-135); same-folder renames never rotate since the node stays in scope.

'sent shares' (GET /shares/sent, Share entity) are live user-to-user grants; 'share-invites' are unclaimed link-based invites that only become a Share on claim — the rotation gate correctly keys off sent shares since only active grants need revocation.

crates/fuse's CipherBoxFS::refresh_sent_shares had zero call sites before this phase — mount init seeded SentSharesCache::empty() and never refreshed it, so Plan 11's new fail-closed gate (D-15a) caused every desktop delete/rename to EIO until wired with a bounded mount-init seed + 30s periodic refresh.
Desktop's query_grants_rooted_at is a no-op — a scope-exit rotation on desktop currently de-authorizes ALL recipients rather than selectively re-minting for still-valid ones (ROT-04 gap).

platform/windows/write_ops.rs duplicates the FUSE gate-ordering logic but can't be cargo-checked on macOS (winfsp-sys needs Windows COM APIs) — fixes to crates/fuse/src/write_ops don't automatically propagate there.
rust-analyzer diagnostics can be stale mid-edit false positives; the authoritative signal is `cargo check`/`cargo test` output, not IDE-reported errors.

sdk-core unit test mocks for unsealChildReadKey unconditionally succeeded regardless of key material, masking a real AEAD key-mismatch bug that only real crypto (via sdk-e2e) could catch — a class of bug structurally invisible to mocked unit tests.

code.finding: collectDirtyFrontier called resolveChildKeyAndEnvelope (which unconditionally AEAD-decrypts) before checking childPub.generation > childRef.generation for dirtiness; fixed to check plaintext generation first and skip decryption entirely for dirty edges (nodeReadKey becomes optional/undefined, recovered later via ECIES checkpoint in repairDirtyNode).

DirtyFrontierEntry widened to include parent_ipns_name/node_read_key/child_pub_kind/enqueued_generation; verify_subtree_clean made recursive via new collect_dirty_frontier stack-based walker; missing root now correctly returns is_dirty:true instead of being treated as clean.

rotate_read_on_scope_exit originally stubbed to always Err (fail-closed, EIO) since only a test FakeDeps implemented RotationDeps; Plan 09 added production FuseRotationDeps adapter and live-wired this call.

sent_shares field converted from plain RwLock to Arc<RwLock<..>> so a spawned periodic refresh task and the mounted fs can share one lock; mount init does a bounded 5s best-effort authoritative seed then spawns a 30s periodic refresh.

workflow: When dispatching multiple worktree-isolated subagents, fire Agent calls one message at a time (not batched in parallel) to avoid a `.git/config.lock` race during simultaneous `git worktree add` — they still execute concurrently once each worktree exists.

Run a synchronous single-plan 'canary' through the full worktree→commit→SUMMARY→merge cycle before fanning out a large wave, to validate the merge mechanics work before committing to N concurrent agents.

Scope `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy` to the specific crate (`-p <crate>`) inside worktree executors, not workspace-wide — an unscoped `cargo fmt --all` leaves unrelated files reformatted-but-uncommitted, which blocks the wave-merge helper with a 'worktree_dirty' error.

After merging a wave that touched a package other than the one immediately under test, rebuild all dependent package dists before running downstream package test suites — a stale dist causes false-negative cross-package test failures that look like real regressions.

For infra-dependent e2e tests (needing live docker/API), have worktree executors write+typecheck the fixture only and defer the actual live run to the orchestrator on the main checkout, keeping worktrees concurrent while controlling the flaky infra-sensitive part centrally.

When a product bug is found by a gate the phase itself introduced (e.g. an anti-vacuous e2e test), delegate a scientific-method diagnosis subagent that must explicitly distinguish 'fixture bug' from 'product bug' before any fix is attempted, and must not paper over failures to get tests green.

Long-running git commit commands that report a tool-level timeout should be verified via `git log` before retrying — the commit frequently already landed and the timeout was just a slow hook (e.g. lint-staged on a large file).

friction: `gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw` emits invalid JSON with literal newlines; had to read the underlying file directly instead.

The GSD commit helper reports false-negative `commit_failed` even when lint-staged actually completed successfully — required verifying via `git log` each time rather than trusting the tool's own status.

Decision-coverage gate failed with an opaque '0/15 covered, malformed bullets' message that gave no indication which bullet was malformed; required manually testing every `**D-` bullet against the parser's three accepted regex forms to find the D-09/D-10 period-vs-colon issue.
`state.planned-phase` tool silently no-op'd (`updated: []`) because STATE.md's format didn't match its expected anchor fields, requiring a manual STATE.md edit.
ROADMAP.md annotate tool also returned `updated: false` (non-blocking) for wave-dependency annotation.
A prompt-injection false-positive fired on a legitimate ROADMAP.md edit (matched an 'act as' pattern in ordinary phase-definition prose).

Cross-plan Rust dist/compile risk: plan 03 (HighWaterStore::put signature change) and plan 04 (engine.rs) forked from different bases and had to be integration-tested together post-merge to catch a possible compile break.

Wave 3 post-merge sdk vitest suite showed 3 spurious failures due to stale sdk-core dist in the main checkout (never rebuilt after Wave 2), which looked like a real cross-plan regression until dists were rebuilt.

sdk-e2e vitest has no dotenv loader wired into its config; running it without first sourcing `.env` causes a silent auth fallback to a default secret and a misleading 401 'Invalid test login secret' error.

Plan 13's agent kept receiving `AskUserQuestion` menu re-fires that the user answered by asking clarifying questions instead of picking an option, requiring the orchestrator to re-issue the same decision three times before the user gave a direct instruction.

CI desktop-e2e run failed on macOS and Linux at the newly authored Step 8 leg (file never propagated to recipient within 18 poll attempts) — a bug in the brand-new leg's setup/poll logic or a real regression, still being triaged when the transcript ends.
Windows leg of desktop-e2e didn't exercise Step 8 at all because plan 13 only added the step to run-all.sh, not run-all.ps1 — a platform-coverage gap discovered only after CI ran.
